sanskrit: dakṣiṇadvāravāme tu bhṛṅgiṇe tu samarcayetpaścimadvāravāme tu vṛṣabhāya namontakamuttaradvāravāme tu gaurīñcaiva tu pūjayettattaddhyānamanusmṛtya arcayettu gurottamaḥtatvadṛṣṭyā viśeṣeṇākṣepamatha śāstrakaiḥghaṇṭāntu tāḍayeddhīmān tri * kāraṃ yathā kurudehālyamadhyame caiva astramantrāṇi pūjayetyāgamaṇṭapakaṃ pūrve bhūmitatvena pūjayetagnitatve namontañca bandheṣu yajanaṃ kramātnamamākāśatatvañca sthūṇānāṃ pūjayettataḥvāsukāyāṃ namontañca darbhamālā supūjayettannāmnena samabhyarcya pādyādīnyupacārakaiḥśrīvatsaṃ svastikañcaiva tannāmneti pūjayetevaṃ krameṇa saṃpūjya śuddhatatvena bhāvayetastreṇa dravyaśuddhiñca ātmānaṃ pūjayettataḥvinyaset hastena dharmādibhirmantrayetkarṇikāyai namo'ntañca mantrāṇāñca smaran guruḥabhimantritapuṃsañca jñānakhaḍgañca saṅgṛhetpañcagavyakrameṇaiva sādhayettu vicakṣaṇaḥtadvaitañca viśeṣeṇa paridhānādyalaṅkṛtamnirīkṣaṇaprokṣaṇañcaiva tāṭanābhyukṣaṇaṃ tathākuṭṭanaṃ secanañcaiva mārjanaṃ lepanaṃ tathāpū * nā rekhayā caiva catuṣpadvīni trikṣipetphālacandanasiddhāsyaiḥ bhasmadūrvākṣatān kuśānkuśakūrcañca saṃgrāhya vardhanyā mūrdhni vinyaset
